say:2:1110133001:1.text: Another hamster... Is he with you?
say:2:1110133001:1.source_cn: ……又一只外来仓鼠。是和你们一起的吗？

say:3:1110133002:1.text: Hey, put me down! Magister, save me!
say:3:1110133002:1.source_cn: 别、别把我拎起来啊！魔法师大人，救救鼠！
say:3:1110133002:1.male: Hey, put me down! Magister, save me!
say:3:1110133002:1.female: Hey, put me down! Magister, save me!

choice_prompt:4:1110133002.text: Hey, put me down! Magister, save me!
choice_prompt:4:1110133002.source_cn: 别、别把我拎起来啊！魔法师大人，救救鼠！
choice_prompt:4:1110133002.male: Hey, put me down! Magister, save me!
choice_prompt:4:1110133002.female: Hey, put me down! Magister, save me!

say:5:1110133003:1.text: From Merlin to talking hamsters? You keep a wide range of company.
say:5:1110133003:1.source_cn: 从梅林到仓鼠？你还真是交游广阔。
say:5:1110133003:1.male: From Merlin to talking hamsters? You keep a wide range of company.
say:5:1110133003:1.female: From Merlin to talking hamsters? You keep a wide range of company.

say:7:1110133004:1.text: Well, that was terrifying. Thank you for saving me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:7:1110133004:1.male: Well, that was terrifying. Thank you for saving me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:7:1110133004:1.female: Well, that was terrifying. Thank you for saving me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:8:1110133005:1.text: Actually, I've discovered treasure nearby! I propose a mutually beneficial partnership to find it.
say:8:1110133005:1.source_cn: 其实，我在附近勘探到了宝藏！我很想和魔法师合作寻宝的——
say:8:1110133005:1.male: Actually, I've discovered treasure nearby! I propose a mutually beneficial partnership to find it.
say:8:1110133005:1.female: Actually, I've discovered treasure nearby! I propose a mutually beneficial partnership to find it.

say:9:1110133006:1.text: If you find yourself interested, be sure to reach out! Farewell!
say:9:1110133006:1.source_cn: 如果你有兴趣，一定要找我哦！回见！
say:9:1110133006:1.male: If you find yourself interested, be sure to reach out! Farewell!
say:9:1110133006:1.female: If you find yourself interested, be sure to reach out! Farewell!

say:12:1110133007:1.text: He disappeared into the sand! Just like last time!
say:12:1110133007:1.source_cn: 和之前一样，迅速钻进沙子里消失了！

say:14:1110133008:0.text: We have urgent business at the moment, but maybe we can find him again when we have spare time.
say:14:1110133008:0.source_cn: 现在我们还有正事要办，闲下来的时候，或许可以找它问问情况……
